name: zentrola
description: Access Zentrola account information, including token usage and the configured service provider.

interface.shortDescription: View Zentrola usage and provider information.
interface.longDescription: Reuse the Zentrola endpoint and Access Key already configured for Codex to query token usage and inspect the configured service provider.
defaultPrompt: Use $zentrola:usage to query my current-month Zentrola token usage.
Use $zentrola:provider to show my current Zentrola service provider.
